children: A Project is the tenancy unit nested under a Workspace — the scope that bounds mutations, webhooks, and edge-projector rebuilds.

Where a Workspace is the outer tenant boundary, a Project is the unit inside it. In Barkpark production each Workspace carries one Project: the default workspace ec0a6b95… holds project 6a9302b2…, and the gyldendal workspace 5638273c… holds project ae13a01b…. Together Workspace + Project form the full tenancy key that every Document and Dataset is filed under in the Content Model.
The Project is the scope that bounds the write and propagation paths:

This keeps the Blue Green Rebuild cycle and Graph Traversal cleanly partitioned: one Project's orphans and dangling references never bleed into another's.

The Project travels with Auth and Tokens on the HTTP API v1 and, like the Workspace, contributes to the tier-keying of the Capabilities Manifest. The bp CLI and JS SDK both carry the Project in their configured context. Reads filtered by Perspective and body content carried as a PortableDoc are likewise bounded by the Project — the inner ring of the tenancy key.
